# foreman_commonparameter (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "foreman_commonparameter" "puppet_server" {
  name           = "puppet_server"
  parameter_type = "string"
  value          = "puppet.example.com"
  hidden_value   = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `parameter_type` (String) Type of value
- `value` (String)

### Optional

- `hidden_value` (Boolean)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import foreman_commonparameter.puppet_server <commonparameter_id>
```
